title: Lakeshore Family Office: lunch discussion on Strategic Income, Floating Rate and Global Bond
description: Lunch meeting recorded on Sam's phone. Elena Petrova holds the Woodgrove Global Bond Fund, Class R6, is considering the Contoso Strategic Income Fund, Class I as a core-plus bond holding and compares it with the Contoso Floating Rate Fund, Advisor class. Restaurant chatter must be dropped, and the three seller tasks use different due-date phrasings (tomorrow, by Thursday, end of next week).

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Elena, great to finally do this in person. Thanks for picking such a nice spot.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Of course, Sam. It's right around the corner from our office, and the lunch menu is always good.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: I can tell. Let me see what's on here. I think I'm going for the club sandwich.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm tempted by the salmon salad. Oh, here comes the waiter. Hi, could I have the salmon salad, please, and a sparkling water?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: And could I get the club sandwich with a side salad, and a sparkling water as well? Thank you.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: So, you mentioned on the phone that you wanted to revisit the fixed income side of the book.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes. Right now our main bond holding is the Woodgrove Global Bond Fund, Class R6. It has done its job, but I'm wondering whether it carries too much currency exposure for what we want.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: That's a fair question. It's a go-anywhere global portfolio, so a good part of what it earns comes from currency and non-US rates, which can make the ride bumpier next to your dollar-based spending needs.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Exactly. So I've been looking at the Contoso Strategic Income Fund, Class I, as a core-plus holding that spreads across more credit sectors.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: It's a natural fit. It spreads across US high yield, investment grade, securitized assets and some emerging markets exposure, and the team can adjust duration fairly actively as rates move.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That active duration piece is what interests me. With rates still uncertain, I don't want to be locked into a big duration bet. How does it compare with the Contoso Floating Rate Fund, Advisor class?

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Good question. The Floating Rate Fund holds senior bank loans that reset with short-term rates, so it has almost no duration, but it's concentrated in below-investment-grade credit and it won't help you if rates fall.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Right, that's the trade-off I'm weighing. The Strategic Income Fund gives me flexibility and diversification, while the floating rate fund gives me more protection if rates stay high.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Exactly. I'll send you a side-by-side comparison of the Strategic Income Fund and the Floating Rate Fund tomorrow.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That would be great. I'd also like to see what a shift would look like in our actual portfolio, maybe ten percent coming out of the global bond fund.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Happy to. I'll run a pro forma on moving ten percent out of the Woodgrove Global Bond Fund and send it to you by the end of next week.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect. One more practical thing, is there a minimum for the Class I shares? I don't want to build a case around it and then find out we can't access it.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Fair point. I'll confirm the minimum with our sales desk and let you know by Thursday.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks. I'll walk Marcus through all of this before we decide anything, since he'll want to see how it fits into the overall allocation.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Makes sense. Oh, it looks like the food is here.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That was quick. The salmon looks great.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Mine too. Let's eat, and thanks again for making the time.

surface_forms: Contoso Strategic Income Fund, Class I
Contoso Floating Rate Fund, Advisor class
Woodgrove Global Bond Fund, Class R6

gold.notes: Ordering food and the waiter are noise to drop. For a Monday call 'tomorrow' is 2026-11-10, 'by Thursday' is 2026-11-12 and 'end of next week' is Friday of the following week, 2026-11-20. Elena walking Marcus (her colleague, con-007) through the options is a customer commitment, not a task.
